name: Tenant settings configuration workflow
description: Export all tenant settings to YAML, edit desired values, review a plan, and apply it with durable continuation across the low hourly API quota.
prerequisites: An authenticated identity authorized for Fabric tenant administration
A private writable directory for exports, reviewed plans, and continuation files
Explicit approval before applying tenant-wide configuration changes

steps.description: Export all pages of current tenant settings.
steps.notes: Keep an original private backup; then edit supported desired values. Omitted settings remain unmanaged.

steps.description: Compare desired values with the live tenant and write a reviewable YAML plan.
steps.notes: Review before/after differences, scope, and destructive warnings. An unchanged export produces no updates.

steps.description: Preview the exact planned scope without updates.
steps.notes: Offline preview does not verify live state. Obtain approval before the next step.

steps.description: Apply the reviewed updates sequentially, preserving progress.
steps.notes: The operation is not transactional. A changed live baseline requires replanning.

recovery.description: On RATE_LIMITED, wait as instructed and resume using the checkpoint reported by the failed command. Export and plan support the same resume pattern.
recovery.notes: Do not combine --continue with fresh inputs, substitute --continuation-token, edit the checkpoint, or blindly restart apply. Retain files privately and use the same tenant.
